epic.title: Epic #567 — the door is the interface, wave 2, lane D1
epic.intent_and_why: Issue #559: remove the CLI as an agent-facing second path from every instruction file the corpus ships, and land a guard that fails if it grows back. The text has been deleted twice and regrown twice, so the deliverable is the mechanism that makes the third deletion stick, not the deletion. Co-travelers #596 (CONSTELLATION_FEEDBACK.md still mandated after the switch to the episode ledger) and #526 (stock close criteria cite a nonexistent build script; no survey-reuse convention) are the same kind of work in the same files.

definition_of_done: No CLI fallback clause and no agent-facing <engine> token survives in this lane's files.
A guard exists that fails if either comes back, red-proofed against a reintroduction and green on a legitimate historical mention.
specs/*.spine.toml carry door vocabulary matching measured behaviour.
#596 and #526 each have an evidenced disposition.
The full suite is green on Linux in a clean detached worktree of the branch, MapTreeFreshnessTests excepted.

good_enough.mandatory_quality: Assert against the text's absence, never against a description of the rule; a guard that loops asserts what it looped over and states the count.
good_enough.sufficient_evidence: Targeted automated tests plus the relevant broader suite (ORCHESTRATOR_CONTEXT, 'Workflow mechanisms and verifiers'), and engine/door behaviour validated in a fresh process with explicit paths.
good_enough.appetite: One extended session; the guard is worth more of the budget than the deletions are.

hard_constraints: File no issues; stage triage candidates as files under .agent-work/567-d1/triage-candidates/.
Promote no observation into docs/agents/* — the human's call.
docs/superpowers/** and episodes/** are historical records; editing one to make a count come out right falsifies the record.
map/INDEX.md is Admiral-owned; MapTreeFreshnessTests may fail and nothing else may.

Fenced this wave: skills/workbench/** and docs/agents/CREW_CONTEXT.md (lane D2), scripts/mcp_spine_server.py and episodes/** (lane E), scripts/run_crew.py (lane F), scripts/checklist_engine.py (lane H).
This lane merges LAST, so the guard is proven against a tree where every other lane has landed.

decision:guard-is-the-deliverable — settled/doctrine: a deletion with no failing-guard demonstration does not close #559.
decision:two-engine-sites-are-not-targets — settled/doctrine: the historical plan record and the init_work_area.py placeholder comment survive.
decision:the-cli-still-exists-for-operators — settled/doctrine: the epic removes the CLI as an agent-facing path, not as a tool.
decision:guard-scope-is-the-existing-corpus-walk — settled/measured: reuse INSTRUCTION_FILES rather than inventing a scope or listing exceptions; exception list length zero.
decision:second-checklist-clauses-are-reworded-not-deleted — Admiral-ruled at F-1: sweep all 13, reword the 3 the door provably cannot reach.
decision:guard-is-authored-first-against-the-dirty-tree — settled/measured: the guard lands before the sweep so its RED comes from the real corpus.
Launched identities remain stable: lane D1 keeps its worktree, branch and spine across the two Commander attempts.

current_wave.objective: Deliver the complete doctrine sweep and the regrowth guard for #559, with #596 and #526 disposed.
exit_criteria: Every gate in execute.json closed with integrated crew evidence.
The guard green over the whole corpus on the rebased tree.

lane-d1-RETURN.md written and the PR opened.

wave_evidence.claim: The regrowth of #559's text has a mechanism, and it is a test.
wave_evidence.expected: A deletion against a green suite.
wave_evidence.observed: tests/test_mcp_adoption.py mandates the text across NINE assertions (lines 737, 784, 834, 950, 954, 1132, 1149, 1324, 1345), one of which fails with 'the CLI door must stay, never be removed or discouraged.' The sweep is an inversion of an existing test, not an addition to a green suite.

wave_evidence.claim: The door cannot drive a second checklist, so 3 of the 13 clauses describe a real path rather than a redundant one.
wave_evidence.expected: The door reaches every agent-facing case, per decision:complete-sweep.
wave_evidence.observed: Fresh-process probe: claim on own spine OK; spine_bind to a second checklist while holding the lease REFUSED ('one door drives one spine at a time'); release-then-bind succeeds, but releasing is barred for a Commander by its own archive provenance check. Confirmed independently three times by the Admiral: lanes F and H each drove execute.json under a hand-supplied CLI session id, and lane E's implementer drove IMPLEMENTER_PLAN.json the same way.
wave_evidence.source: notes-1.md M1, fresh python3 process with explicit paths; Admiral addendum ruling F-1

wave_evidence.claim: The guard's scope needs no exception list.
wave_evidence.expected: An exception-list-shaped answer decaying toward the sibling guard's 11 entries.
wave_evidence.observed: The repo's own INSTRUCTION_FILES walk puts all 10 target files IN and both pre-ruled survivors OUT by the structural rule alone. Exception list length ZERO, measured.
wave_evidence.source: tests/test_mcp_adoption.py:424-432; guard census reproduced independently by the g1 reviewer

wave_evidence.claim: The guard as authored at g1 catches the observed regrowth route but not the route a fresh author would take.
wave_evidence.expected: Three patterns sufficient for the behaviour.
wave_evidence.observed: A spine-template command line never contains the literal checklist_engine.py, so the whole class rested on the single token '<engine>'. '<cli> claim --session-id ...', '<engine-cli> advance ...' and '{{engine}} release ...' all pass clean. Verified by the g1 reviewer with 27 crafted regrowth strings, 13 missed, 12 of them inside a declared limit.

wave_evidence.claim: A skills/-only sweep does not close #559 in this repo.
wave_evidence.expected: skills/** is the whole agent-facing surface.
wave_evidence.observed: .agent-work/templates/ is a TRACKED overlay that workbench doctrine tells agents to PREFER when instantiating. It carries 7 <engine> occurrences and 2 CLI fallback clauses, mirrored again under .baseline/, and all five files are byte-identical to their skills/ sources today. The launch order's own acceptance test — instantiate a fresh spine and read its imperatives — fails on a skills/-only sweep.
wave_evidence.source: Commander measurement at g1-integrate; g1 reviewer triage candidate tc1

wave_evidence.claim: #526 defect 1 no longer reproduces; defect 2 does.
wave_evidence.expected: Possibly stale (the Admiral grepped skills/commander/ and found no match).
wave_evidence.observed: PRELIMINARY, to be confirmed at g4: 'scripts/code_map/build.py' and 'code_map/check.py' appear nowhere under skills/, docs/ or specs/ — only docs/CONSTELLATION_OVERVIEW.md names the scripts/code_map package correctly. But the survey-reuse convention is still undocumented: skills/reviewer/SKILL.md:30 documents --override-reason and the BLOCK/APPROVE asymmetry, and nothing documents appending a recheck item as a sibling and re-consolidating across rounds.
wave_evidence.source: Commander grep at g1, to be re-established by the g4 crew

wave_evidence.claim: The widened stand-in pattern is earned, not over-eager.
wave_evidence.expected: A widening either misses the route or red-lights honest text; the repo's own measured argument is that the second kind gets deleted by the next author who trips it.
wave_evidence.observed: The g1b reviewer re-derived the census with its OWN walk, written from the stated rules rather than by importing the guard, and matched the guard figure for figure: 3098 texts across 216 files, standin 26 matches at 23 addresses. New addresses the widening adds: ZERO. False alarms on honest text: 0 of 3098, against the deleted polarity predicate's 5 of 6 planted honest affirmatives.

wave_evidence.claim: A hand-maintained list inside the guard had already drifted from its oracle on day one.
wave_evidence.observed: _ENGINE_VERBS enumerated 17 verbs where checklist_engine.py's argparse defines 18: 'resume' was missing, so 'Second path: <cli> resume g1 --reason ...' passed all four patterns clean. The reviewer BLOCKed on it, proving the verb set against the engine's --help rather than against a document. It breaks CREW_CONTEXT.md's Verification Discipline verbatim: 'define a guard by its consumer's behaviour, not by a hand-maintained list ... the gap is silent.'

wave_evidence.claim: Every command postcondition in this plan could not pass.
wave_evidence.expected: The cold critic's repair for 'a check that cannot fail' -- prefix set -o pipefail -- made the checks sound.
wave_evidence.observed: The engine runs command checks through _find_posix_shell(), which on POSIX returns shutil.which('sh'); /bin/sh here is dash, which rejects 'set -o pipefail' with 'Illegal option', exit 2, before the check's own logic runs. Five checks affected. The repair for a check that cannot FAIL produced five that cannot PASS, and neither the plan author, the critic, nor the Commander who later rescoped three of them noticed -- a crew that tried to run one found it.
wave_evidence.source: g1b implementer; reproduced directly by the Commander against /bin/sh

wave_evidence.claim: The standard whole-suite evidence command is unsafe while driving the engine.
wave_evidence.expected: A crew running pytest tests/ -q measures the tree, not itself.
wave_evidence.observed: tests/test_gauge_chain_writer_to_trip.py:604 snapshots size+mtime of every file under the repo's .agent-work/ and asserts it unchanged. The g1b reviewer measured 7 failed while recording survey checks and 6 failed when quiet; the 7th was its own write. It nearly reported its own side effect as a defect in someone else's work.

discrepancies.signal: Every command postcondition in this lane's execute.json opened with 'set -o pipefail' and therefore could not pass under the shell the engine runs checks in.

discrepancies.reason: Corrected in place through the engine's retext-check verb and re-verified under dash in all three directions. The class -- nothing enforces the POSIX-form rule that global-everyone.md already states -- is staged as a triage candidate, since scripts/checklist_engine.py is lane H's and doctrine promotion is the human's call.
